text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*munch... munch... munch... munch...*
*munch... munch... munch... munch...*

After taking Tosen Jordan to the fast food joint,
she began inhaling burgers like they were drinks.
choice_data_list: Do you really like burgers that much?
You really like burgers, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well... my parents are super straight-laced health freaks, y'know?
Couldn't touch this stuff growing up, so now it's, like, the opposite?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you're a trainer, so I figured you'd stop me.
Look, look, I'm packing on crazy calories right now. You cool with that?
choice_data_list: Once in a while is fine, isn't it?
Every once in a while is totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *phew*... Thanks for the grub. Later.

Having eaten her fill, Tosen Jordan got up to leave.
I debated stopping her, but I didn't want to force a conversation.

I'll wait for the next chance.
As I watched her go quietly—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Aren't you weird? You're totally throwing off my groove, for real.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...My hooves, y'know? They're, like, super weak.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Got injured right after enrolling and had to sit out.
By the time I came back, everyone had totally left me in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! Just two—no, four more laps!
Not yet, not yet... ngh—ouch!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...You get scared, right? But you run, right? Then you get hurt again, right?
Then you rest, get left behind again, and it's just, like, on repeat forever!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The gap is insane. Between me and everyone in my class. Like, haven't I lost
enough for a lifetime? Just losing and losing and losing constantly...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why right now, I'm...
I guess I'm just, like... totally unmotivated.

Tosen Jordan certainly looked unmotivated at first glance.
However, watching her actions closely—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If only... If only you weren't like this............
If you were just tougher—give me a break. For real.

The way she carefully massaged her legs despite all her grumbling
didn't look like someone who had given up.
choice_data_list: Are you really unmotivated?
Are you sure you're really unmotivated?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I mean, during that mock race the other day, I tried to run,
but I dunno, I just couldn't run properly at all...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I ran like I didn't give a crap, y'know?
Everyone says so too. So—
choice_data_list: I thought you were running with everything you had.
I thought you were giving it your absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Wasn't that the case?
Wasn't that what you were doing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
............Y-Yeah. That was the plan.
But, like... it's not like what I think can be trusted anyway.
choice_data_list: Why do you say that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I've always been bad at school. Clumsy with my hands, get into fights
all the time. I've got nothing going for me, I'm a total screw-up.
choice_data_list: What about racing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Racing is... I... I love racing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
............Taking first place feels amazing. Only then
does everyone look at me like, 'Whoa, she's incredible.'

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So racing is... Only on the track—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Out there, it feels like maybe even I can do something, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I just really, really wanted to win.
I felt like I had finally uncovered her true feelings.
choice_data_list: Do you still want to win?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I want... to win...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—B-But, I don't wanna lose!
I hate losing! I don't wanna look lame anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I... I only ever had racing...!
And yet I can't win at all anymore, not at all—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: If I lose any more, I'll literally have nothing left!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win! I wanna win so bad! Win, and win, and win, and keep winning,
and be like, 'See? I'm totally awesome after all!' Out there again—!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But I dunno what to do! When I think about what if I can't
run right again, I just, like, dread racing!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And everyone else is working hard, so then I start hating school too!
I know I won't win next time like this, but—
choice_data_list: Then let's train together.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

Being so terrified of defeat precisely because she desires victory so badly—
very few horsegirls possess such an intense obsession with winning.
choice_data_list: Your desire to win is your greatest weapon.
That hunger to win is your greatest weapon.

text_block_list.text:
For instance, when dueling down to the wire before the finish line,
the one who ultimately seizes victory is the horsegirl who wants it more.
choice_data_list: It would be a waste for you to give up on racing.
It'd be such a waste for you to give up on racing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, but, I mean... e-even so!
Even if I try, what if I can't run properly when it counts—
choice_data_list: The only reason you couldn't run was because you were too scared.
You couldn't run because fear held you back.

text_block_list.text:
Extreme fear can sometimes cause hyperventilation and anemia. That was
likely the real reason she couldn't run properly in her mock races.
choice_data_list: If you tackle it with confidence, you'll definitely run just fine.
If you tackle it with confidence, you'll definitely run just fine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For real...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, but... everyone else is already crazy fast, and, y'know, my hooves
are weak. What if I get injured again—
choice_data_list: Don't worry. Leave that part to me.
Don't worry. Leave that part to me.

text_block_list.text:
A slight setback can easily be overcome with the right training. As for her
hooves, we just need a routine designed around them. I told her firmly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you really are weird.
I'm not even your trainee, so how can you say all that with a straight face?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Still, why is that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Somehow... I'm actually starting to feel like I can win.

Before I knew it, the tense look on her face had vanished,
replaced instead by a feisty, cheeky grin.
